# WowSims Exporter
An exporter addon for World Of Warcraft: Classic Sims at https://www.wowsims.com/

Supports Classic Era/Anniversary, Season of Discovery, TBC, WotLK, Cataclysm and Mists of Pandaria Classic, and WoW Forever (https://www.wowsims.com/forever/).

The WoW Forever talent table in `Flavors/Forever/Talents.lua` is generated from the sim's talent trees. Regenerate it with `python3 tools/gen_forever_talents.py <path to a wowsims/forever checkout>` when they change, and check it with `npm ci --prefix tools/test && node tools/test/forever_talents.js <same path>`, which replays every talent string from the sim's presets through the export. The Forever talents workflow does both daily, and opens and merges a PR when the table changes.

The Interface versions workflow checks Blizzard's version service daily and opens a PR (for review) adding the interface number of any new client build to the TOC. Run it locally with `python3 tools/update_interface_versions.py`.

There is a channel on the wowsims discord call integrations to talking real time to people, please don't use the discord for support if it can be avoided please use the issue tracker. we may request to talk to you in the integrations channel involving a pull request or an issue though that's fine.

Invite is located here https://discord.gg/N9ZgAMXQ3p

**Getting the addon**

If anyone would like to test it, you can just download it from the releases page and you can also find it on Curseforge!

please use curseforge if you can as it helps support my programming endeavors!

**To use the addon**

    /wse - will open up the options window - *wip* changes do nothing atm
    /wse open - will open the exporter window.
    /wse export will open the exporter window, generate the data, and have the data ready and highlighted for you to CTRL+C

If you change your gear, talents, enchants, glyphs or runes, you can either rerun `/wse export` if you closed the window and the data will be updated. or just click the `Generate Data` button.

# INFO
The aim for this project is to have an addon to export your characters gear, enchants, talents, and runes to wowsims.github.io.

# CONTRIBUTING
If you would like to contribute, please feel free!

**Code structure**

    Core/            Shared by every game version: flavor detection and registration, professions,
                     spec lookup, tooltips, the bag export filter
    Talents/         Talent and glyph readers shared by several game versions
    Flavors//  One folder per game version. Flavor.lua calls Env.RegisterFlavor{...} with
                     everything that differs for that version (sim URL, classes, item fields,
                     events, talents, glyphs, item extras); other files hold its data and helpers
    ExportStructures/, UI.lua, WowSimsExporter.lua
                     Version independent: they only read Env.Flavor

See the field list at the top of `Core/Flavor.lua`. To support a new game version, add a
`Flavors/<Name>/` folder, list its files in the TOC with `[AllowLoadGameType ...]`, and add a fake
client for it in `tools/test/wow_mock.lua`.

**Tests**

`npm ci --prefix tools/test && node tools/test/snapshots.js` runs every game version's export against
a fake client and compares it with `tools/test/snapshots/`. After an intended change, rerun it with
`--update` and commit the new snapshots. CI runs it on every pull request.

It was created using World of Warcraft Addon Creator 2015, its a very good IDE based on visual studio, its not required to be used, but if new files are added, please adjust the project file to match if not using WoWAC2015.

**Translations**

User-facing strings live in `Locales/`. Strings are keyed by their English text in `Locales/enUS.lua`; to add a language, copy `Locales/zhCN.lua`, change the locale code passed to `Env.RegisterLocale`, translate the values and add the file to `WowSimsExporter.toc`. Missing keys fall back to English.

- WowSims 4.0 beta3: settings page, About tab, bank, loot rolls, shopping list, chat links  
    - Settings move to the game's options (Options > AddOns > WowSimsExporter):

      read from whatever the client defines (retail Enum.BagIndex on Forever).

      gems compared with the sim's set; shift-click to link, or copy the list.  
    - Gear Sets: "Link" puts [WowSims: Set Name] in chat. Other WowSims users  
      can click it to get the set (AceComm whisper) in their Import tab.  
    - Minimap button: right-click menu with quick actions.  
    - English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese for all new text.  
    - Tests: bank export with the bank open, and the settings page.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Merge the LibParse removal into beta  
    Brings in main (including v3.2.10's bag export fix) and switches the 4.0  
    features to the built-in encoder: GenerateOutput and Gear Sets now call  
    Env.JSONEncode. Gear Sets used an unset global LibParse, so exporting a  
    gear set errored; this fixes it.  
    Snapshots: same exports, now shown as real JSON.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Replace LibParse with a built-in JSON encoder  
    Core/Json.lua writes the same JSON LibParse did (arrays up to the highest  
    index with null gaps, [] for empty tables, everything else an object), with  
    sorted keys so the output is stable. LibParse is removed from embeds.xml,  
    .pkgmeta and the project; Ace3 stays.  
    Tests now use the real encoder and show exports as pretty-printed JSON, so  
    the snapshots show [] and null where the old stand-in printed {} and sparse  
    keys. tools/test/json.js checks the encoder's edge cases and runs in CI.  
    Encoder and its test from #79.  
    Co-Authored-By: Kayla Glick <kaylaglick12@gmail.com>  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

- README: WowSims for WoW Forever and releases; keep test snapshots LF  
- WowSims 4.0 (beta): from exporter to full WowSims addon for Forever  
    Everything new is Forever-only; Classic Era, SoD, TBC, Wrath, Cata and Mists  
    run the original exporter code unchanged.  
    Export and inspect  
    - Inspect other players (target, Inspect frame button, or right-click a  
      player's portrait) and export their gear, talents and professions.  
    - Forever names as "Firstname Surname"; item links parsed in the newer format.  
    - Export options: include gear/talents/professions; warn about missing  
      enchants and empty sockets.  
    New tabs  
    - Gear Sets: save, equip, compare, export, send all sets to the sim.  
    - Stat Weights: paste the sim's Pawn export; upgrade lines on item tooltips.  
    - Upgrades: bag items that beat your gear (with Equip) and gear missing  
      enchants or gems.  
    - Inspect: target card, export history with Copy / Gear / Talents / Delete,  
      professions from linked trade skills or picked by hand.  
    - Group: ask your group or guild for exports from anywhere (AceComm), see  
      who has WowSims; sharing can be turned off.  
    - Import: paste the sim's JSON or saved data; gear on a 3D model and paper  
      doll, score vs. what you wear, talent comparison, apply talents (via a  
      trainer, never a reset), professions, save as a gear set.  
    - Settings: minimap button, tooltips, export options, replay the tour.  
    Also  
    - Talent viewer for any class with prerequisite lines (trees generated  
      from the Forever sim).  
    - Tutorial: first-open welcome and a tour of every tab (/wowsims tour).  
    - Version check between WowSims users in guild and group (/wowsims version).  
    - English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese strings for everything new.  
    - Solid window background, remembered window size, minimum window sizes,  
      scrollbars on every tab.

    - Snapshot every registered spec's link and fail on unlisted pages

- chore: sync Forever talent table with wowsims/forever (#86)  
    Co-authored-by: generalwrex <1731139+generalwrex@users.noreply.github.com>  
- chore: sync Forever talent table with wowsims/forever (#85)  
    Co-authored-by: generalwrex <1731139+generalwrex@users.noreply.github.com>  
- feat: add zhTW (Traditional Chinese) locale  
    Adds a full zhTW translation covering the same keys as zhCN (62 keys,  
    including the two Show Startup Message strings), registered as its own  
    locale file and loaded from the TOC. RegisterLocale only applies it when  
    the client locale is zhTW, so loading it elsewhere is a no-op.  
- feat: add option to disable the startup message  
    Adds a 'Show Startup Message' toggle to the addon options (defaults to  
    enabled, preserving current behavior). When disabled, the initialization  
    message with the command list is no longer printed to chat on login.  
    - New showStartupMessage profile default in SavedDataManager  
    - Options toggle wired with AceConfig (order 3, double width)  
    - Startup print gated behind 'showStartupMessage ~= false'  
    - enUS + zhCN locale entries  
- chore: sync Forever talent table with wowsims/forever (#81)  
    Co-authored-by: generalwrex <1731139+generalwrex@users.noreply.github.com>  
- chore: sync Forever talent table with wowsims/forever (#78)  
    Co-authored-by: generalwrex <1731139+generalwrex@users.noreply.github.com>  
- Merge pull request #71 from dodoels/feat/i18n-zhcn  
    Add localization support (enUS + zhCN)  
- Offer wowsimscn.com next to the international site on zhCN  
    On Forever with a zhCN client, the main tab shows two copyable links:  
    the international sim (wowsims.com/forever) and the China mirror  
    (wowsimscn.com). The mirror only serves its root, so no spec path is  
    appended. Other clients/locales are unchanged.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Add localization support with enUS and zhCN  
    Introduce a lightweight locale system (Locales/Locale.lua) with no new  
    library dependency. All user-facing strings in the UI, options, chat  
    messages and saved-data manager now go through Env.L, keyed by their  
    English text, with a full Simplified Chinese (zhCN) translation.  
    Unsupported-class message now lists localized class names.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Merge pull request #77 from wowsims/feat/forever-talent-marker  
    feat: export the game flavor with each character  
- feat: export the game flavor instead of a talent tree marker  
    Replace the Forever-only "talentTrees" key with "flavor", set by every flavor:  
    era, sod, tbc, wrath, cata, mists or forever. A sim can now tell which client  
    an export came from. The Forever sim uses it to apply talent strings only from  
    Forever exports. The existing "version" key is the addon release, the same on  
    every client, so it can't do this. The sod, tbc, wotlk, cata and mop addon  
    importers read top-level keys one by one, so the new key is ignored there.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- feat: mark Forever talent strings as built from the Forever sim's trees  
    Forever exports now carry "talentTrees": "forever". The Forever sim drops  
    imported talent strings because an Era/SoD export has the same shape but  
    indexes different trees; the marker lets it apply only strings this flavor  
    built from its own tree order. Other flavors don't set the field, so their  
    exports are unchanged.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Merge pull request #76 from wowsims/fix/forever-guards  
    fix: harden Forever talents and version guards found by comparing with forever-beta  
- test: load files like the real client and cover missing Forever talent APIs  
    The snapshot harness now loads a file when the client recognises none of its  
    AllowLoadGameType values, as the game does. The classic clients don't know  
    camelot, so their snapshots load the Forever files and exercise the IS\_FOREVER  
    guard; removing it now fails all six classic snapshots. The Forever snapshot  
    gains exports through C\_ClassTalents and with no talent API at all.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- fix: guard the remaining version-specific files by flavor  
    ClassicTrees.lua, Glyphs.lua and Cata/Reforge.lua relied only on their  
    AllowLoadGameType line. A client that recognises none of the listed game types  
    loads the file anyway, and ClassicTrees.lua calls GetNumTalentTabs on  
    SPELLS\_CHANGED. Return early like the other files under Flavors/.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- fix: keep the Forever export working when talents can't be read  
    GetForeverTalentRanks called C\_SpecializationInfo.GetCombatConfigIDForSpecGroup  
    unguarded. Only the test mock defines it, so on a client without it the spec  
    lookup raised an error and /wse export produced no gear. Read the config through  
    C\_ClassTalents.GetActiveConfigID first, fall back to the spec group lookup, and  
    return nil (empty talents) when neither exists.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Merge pull request #73 from wowsims/feat/wow-forever-support  
    feat: add WoW Forever support  
- Merge pull request #75 from wowsims/refactor/flavo
